about: I'm Yosef Bartolumeus Dias, Digital Marketing Supervisor at Anemone Indonesia in Denpasar, Bali. For the past three years I've focused on paid ads, from lead generation all the way to franchise sales.
Before that I created content, hosted live selling, and wrote for SEO. That's why I know great ads need clean numbers and creative that makes people stop scrolling.

plansNote: Pick the plan that matches how your brand wants to share risk. Ad budget is paid directly to the platforms and is separate from my fee.

faq.q: Does the fee include the ad budget?
faq.a: No. Your brand pays the ad budget directly to the ad platforms. My fee of Rp4M or Rp3M per month is separate from that budget.

faq.q: How is the success fee calculated?
faq.a: The success fee is a percentage of every closing that comes from the ads. We agree on the percentage, what counts as a closing, and how it's tracked before we start.

faq.q: Which ad platforms do you handle?
faq.a: Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok Ads, and Google Ads, depending on your needs and business goals.
Ad spend, lead volume, lead quality, conversions through to closing, ROAS, and acquisition cost, plus analysis of what worked and the plan for next steps.

faq.q: What kind of business is the best fit?
faq.a: Businesses that want to measure ads all the way to sales, especially lead-driven ones like franchises, services, and high-value products.
